pages.title: Composition
pages.body: This entire scene is a small composition. Scene owns components, defineScene exports the Artlab lifecycle, and EmberField contains the motion and color rules. Change count or radius and press Run.

pages.title: Ember motion
pages.body: EmberField extends InstanceField. It keeps particle positions and velocities, rotates their motion, respawns escaped particles, and writes transforms and colors into shared instance buffers. The artistic rules stay here; Three setup and buffer ownership live in the shared class.

pages.title: Shared rendering class
pages.body: InstanceField owns one geometry and material, one InstancedMesh, and reusable scratch transforms. Each set call changes one particle; commit marks the buffers for upload. Edit this class and Run to see the change in the scene. The exported package includes your edited class.

pages.title: Scene lifecycle
pages.body: Scene.use attaches a component and registers ownership. The update loop calls each component; disposal releases them. defineScene keeps a distinct instance for each runtime context and translates the class into setup/update/teardown exports.
